notes.title: New features update on March 12, 2025
notes.content: New video adjustments functions: brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, and white balance.

notes.title: Next version release announcement
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the latest update to Nero AI Video Upscaler, introducing powerful video adjustment features designed to elevate your video enhancement experience. With this update, you can now fine-tune your videos with adjustable brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, and white balance settings, allowing for greater control over visual clarity and aesthetic appeal.

Key Features of the Update:

Brightness Adjustment: Modify the lightness or darkness of your video to achieve the desired exposure levels.

Contrast Control: Enhance the difference between the light and dark areas, adding depth and dimension to your footage.

Saturation Tuning: Adjust the intensity of colors to make your video more vibrant or achieve a subdued, muted look.

Sharpness Enhancement: Improve the clarity and detail of your video, making edges more distinct and visuals more defined.

White Balance Correction: Ensure accurate color representation by adjusting the color temperature, making your video appear more natural under different lighting conditions.

These enhancements are part of our ongoing commitment to provide you with cutting-edge tools that harness the power of artificial intelligence for superior video quality. The update is now available, and we invite you to explore these new features to transform your videos into stunning visual masterpieces.

notes.title: New features update on November 19, 2024
notes.content:
New feature updates:
[list]
[*] Added a new model: Versatile, which is used to reduce artifacts after magnification and provide clear and natural image effects.
[*] Added AI interpolation function to increase the video frame rate and generate additional video frames to smooth the video.
[*] Added AI slow motion function to convert ordinary videos into smooth slow motion videos.
[/list]
